scientific.scope: Final report and exact readback of independent-auditor correction; no numerical rerun.
qualifications_confirmed: Full-pool projected triple overlap does not establish actual historical five-shot canvas leakage.
Two-of-eight manual label errors concern the ask_new=False branch, not contamination of historical forced-query scores.
Grounding loss is not attributed to historical models that had no grounding.
Constant and presence controls are constructed witnesses, not identified trained-model mechanisms.
Joint renaming uses two tiny untrained models and manually activated NeuroPixel updates.
High conditional retention is accompanied by weak base binding and many stably wrong predictions.
The distractor recount uses five previously observed shared-bag realizations, with no new inference or external replication.
